Aisha K (AM): FYI - Sundance signed the NDA and wants to start a 2-week POC. Scope: multilingual embeddings + conversational snippets. Requirements: EU-only data, FIPS KMS, deterministic tokenization for legal redaction, p95 <120ms, and committed pricing for 6 months if POC looks good.
Tom (Sales): Nice. Do they expect Dedicated from day 1? Any qps estimate?
Aisha K (AM): They said Dedicated preferred for isolation, but open to hosted POC if we can show numbers. Expect ~60 qps burst, steady ~20 qps, avg payloads ~120 tokens. Mostly embeddings + short chat turns.
Diego (eng-ml): Tech note: multilingual embeddings are fine on the 13B family. Deterministic tokenization is the sticky bit. Options:
- Client-side tokenizer normalization (easy, hosted ok)
- Custom tokenizer artifact (requires Private/Dedicated with artifact pinning)
We can also run a quantized 13B to reduce memory.
Tom (Sales): Can you do a quick hosted smoke to prove latency & cost before we push Dedicated procurement? Customer wants numbers for their C-suite.
Diego (eng-ml): Will do. Plan: 1-hour soak, 10k embedding calls + 2k chat turns using llama-13b-q4f16. Metrics: p95 latency, avg token charge, KV cache hit. Also record cold vs warm p95.
Nina (security): FIPS KMS is not standard on Hosted. We support customer-managed FIPS KMS on Private/Dedicated. Need their security contact + any compliance questionnaire. Also ask about DLP/redaction guarantees.
Aisha K (AM): I'll ask for a security contact and sample corpus (1k multilingual lines).
Diego (eng-ml): Starting hosted smoke now with a small subset (using client-side normalized tokens). Will paste results shortly.
Infra-Bot: deploy 2026-03-23T09:12:12Z - status: success
Diego (eng-ml): Paste results: run id smoke-509876-a (1h, subset)
```
- model: llama-13b-q4f16
- requests: 3k embeddings + 800 chat turns
- tokens processed: ~28,400
- KV cache hit: 46%
- p95 (embeddings): 72ms
- p95 (chat): 108ms (warm cache)
- p95 cold-start: 260ms (single-node cold)
- hosted estimated cost for scaled 1-month POC: ~$2.2k - $3.8k (depends on token volume & cache reuse)
- dedicated 8x A100-equivalent reserve: estimate $20k - $26k/mo depending on term and network egress
```
Diego (eng-ml): Notes: warm cache matters a lot for chat p95. Deterministic tokenization via client-side shim produced identical token streams across runs. If they require server-side artifact pinning for legal audit, we'll need Dedicated/private.
Tom (Sales): Great — those p95 numbers look promising. Can we produce a 1-page summary for the execs with a recommended path (hosted smoke -> Dedicated commit) and rough costs?
Diego (eng-ml): Yep. Draft recommendation:
- Phase 1 (Hosted smoke, 1 week): prove perf & accuracy using client-side tokenizer. Deliverable: perf report + tokenization diff.
- Phase 2 (Short Dedicated trial, 2 weeks): provision 8x pool with FIPS KMS + EU residency, run full corpus, validate redaction/integrations.
- Phase 3 (Commit decision): 6-month reserved pricing + SLA.
Tom (Sales): Perfect. Nina: can you draft the questionnaire answers we can hand to their security team? Also any pricing add-on for 90-day audit log retention?
Nina (security): Yes. We can support 90-day retention as an add-on for Dedicated/Private. I'll draft answers and call out where Hosted is insufficient (FIPS). Need their security contact and a few clarifications on data flow.
Aisha K (AM): Action items: I will collect security contact + representative corpus today. Diego to run full hosted smoke once corpus received. Nina to prepare sec questionnaire answers and add-on pricing. Tom to assemble the exec one-pager.
Tom (Sales): I'll also loop in AE and Legal. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
Diego (eng-ml): Starting the full hosted run once corpus lands. ETA results: same day if corpus <5k lines.
Aisha K (AM): Sundance is excited to start this week. I'll post the contact when they reply.
Infra-Bot: note: infra ticket #INF-2245 created for Dedicated sizing review
Tom (Sales): Keep this thread updated.
